name: GPS-Gaussian Network Architecture
definition: A single-image regression network that predicts pixel-wise 3D Gaussian parameter maps (position, rotation, scaling, opacity, color) for real-time novel view synthesis.
summary: The GPS-Gaussian Network is a single-image regression method that predicts 3D Gaussian parameters for real-time novel view synthesis, distinguished by its independent encoder and re-indexed correlation volume for over 30% efficiency gains.
